items.scope:
Root Scope: Alphabet organizations.
CNA Scope: Google products, including open source software published and maintained by Google, and vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Google that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
Lexmark products only.
All CrowdStrike products.
ABB issues only.
Forcepoint products only.
Roche’s medical technology products.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
All SAP products.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.
All Arista products only.
Zscaler issues only.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
Bosch products only.
Xerox Corporation issues only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
SailPoint issues only.
Jaspersoft products and services only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
Siemens issues only.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Yugabyte products only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
NVIDIA issues only.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
Third-party products he researches that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to TCS-CERT’s customers’ environment and vulnerabilities related to research conducted by Cyber Solutions by Thales’ Intrusion and Application Security Team.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
AMD branded products and technologies only. AMD does not evaluate, remediate, or issue CVE IDs for vulnerabilities that only affect End-of-Life/End-of-Support products and technologies.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Kong products; Kong Konnect, Kong Enterprise, Kong Mesh, and Kong Insomnia, including Kong Opensource; Kong Gateway, Kuma, Insomnia.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.

Vulnerabilities in Protect AI products, third-party code vulnerabilities reported by researchers collaborating with huntr and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Protect AI that are not in another CNA’s scope.
